_note: Single source of the vault's page classes (wiki-reliability plan, D5). reindex.py builds its index sections + order from this; lint.py derives CONTENT (the stub-lifecycle scaffold-check scope) from the `content` flag. Previously both hand-duplicated the list — the enforcement machinery had the same multi-source-of-truth rot it exists to catch. Keep in sync with AGS-WIKI.md §8 (index sections) and §12 (lint scope).

fields.label: the index.md section heading
fields.extra: an extra frontmatter field surfaced as a column, or null
fields.content: true for the content-lifecycle classes lint.py's scaffold-stub check scopes to (CONTENT); false for sources + the campaign classes
fields.campaign: true for campaign-authored classes that render a placeholder row when empty (CAMPAIGN)
